papers.title: Efficient Whole‐Body Model Predictive Control for Online Compliant Dual‐Arm Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Dual‐arm mobile manipulators can transport and manipulate large objects with simple end‐effectors. Interacting with dynamic environments subject to strict safety and compliance requirements, achieving whole‐body motion planning online while meeting various hard constraints for highly redundant mobile manipulators poses a significant challenge. We tackle this challenge by presenting an efficient whole‐body motion‐planning approach based on model‐based predictive control (MPC). We construct a hierarchical MPC framework in which the first MPC optimizes the end‐effectors' collision‐free motion, thereby guiding the second MPC to optimize whole‐body joint trajectories. In the first stage, we employ a Bézier‐curve representation to parameterize the high‐degree‐of‐freedom (high‐DOF) motion in  of two collaborating end‐effectors, notably introducing a novel and efficient method to optimize quaternion trajectories. This facilitates fast long‐horizon motion planning of coupled translational and rotational trajectories while accounting for approximated feasibility constraints. In the second stage, this is the first work to novelly incorporate the representation into a whole‐body MPC for online high‐DOF motion generation with predictive admittance control over a relatively short horizon while satisfying whole‐body hard constraints. Compared with the usage of a discretization approach, our whole‐body MPC ensures accurate model‐state transitions with faster, more stable computation speeds, and consistent motion command generation which enhances tracking performance for our hybrid position/velocity‐controlled robot. Both MPCs perform replanning in each control loop to adapt to a changing environment. Simulations and real‐world experiments validate the proposed hierarchical MPC framework, demonstrating that its two novel MPCs achieve efficient and robust performance in scenarios involving static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, compliant interaction with manipulated objects, and external disturbances.</jats:p>
papers.scope: 2024预印本v1 III框架/参数化/预测导纳与IV相关实验；2026期刊仅元数据及出版社摘要，未比对最终方法全文。
papers.read_title: An Efficient Representation of Whole-body Model Predictive Control for Online Compliant Dual-arm Mobile Manipulation
anchors: III-A：MPC-T任务轨迹、MPC-W全身关节轨迹及力参考
III-B：Bezier参数化保持位置/速度命令一致
III-D：位置/速度接口与腕力预测导纳；小末端质量/基座加速度条件下省略一惯性项
papers.method: 两层MPC先规划双手任务运动，再求全身关节运动；预测导纳把受力偏差转换为运动修正。
